verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs show push approve/deny MFA requests with number matching ('Tap or enter the corresponding number, then Approve'). They also show location sharing used to enforce country-based access, and administrators controlling whether work accounts can use notifications; community reports confirm companies enforce Authenticator push-only MFA. Missing for 10: evidence that the push prompt displays sign-in location or app context to the user, detailed admin documentation on configuring number-matching and MFA policies, and independent hands-on corroboration of number matching as a phishing defense.
